findings: CLEAR and RESET clear title/subtitle without erasing action-bar overlay.
RESET restores native GUI 10/70/20 tick defaults; common receipts retain ResetToDefaults rather than inventing received tick values.
Legacy cache reset/clear and border INITIALIZE warning order corrected; both native border codecs encode warning distance before delay.

lightweight_validation: 42 packets generated/read/written by original native codecs (21/version), all title operations, complete BMP header/footer pair, all border operations and signed 0/2^45/Long.MAX_VALUE/-1 durations with legacy milliseconds/modern ticks and checked nominal conversion. Per-field unchanged origin preservation; every truncation/trailing-field atomic refusal; invalid title/border operations and boolean refusal; border generation invalidation and partial fresh-world receipts; actual adapter clear/reset/header/footer application and disconnect/failure fencing.

findings: Legacy moving extent calculates remaining time against Util.getMillis().
Modern moving extent stores remaining ticks, decrements once in update(), packet constructor uses getLerpTime() unchanged.
Modern WorldBorderCommand takes TimeArgument ticks and formats seconds by dividing by 20; 5 without suffix produced native duration 5, while 5s produces 100 ticks.
